# Robots parsers use the most-specific matching User-agent group and do not
# merge that group with User-agent: *. Repeat shared Allow rules in explicit
# bot groups when those bots need the same render dependencies as standard crawlers.

# ===== Standard crawlers (unchanged from today) =====
User-agent: *
Allow: /v4/md/applications/crunchbase
Allow: /*.js$
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /register
Disallow: /account
Disallow: /reset-password
Disallow: /subscriptions
Disallow: /contribute
Disallow: /add-new
Disallow: /edit
Disallow: /buy
Allow: /buy/select-product
Disallow: /account-setup
Disallow: /verify
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /v4
Disallow: /home
Disallow: /search
Disallow: /discover
Disallow: /textsearch

# ===== TIER 1: AI answer/search agents - ALLOW all paths =====
# They cite us -> citations + funnel. This group can crawl all paths on www.
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: Meta-ExternalFetcher
# + xAI/Grok answer agent once its UA token is published (verify)
# Note: Applebot (Siri/Spotlight) & bingbot (Copilot) are search engines already
# governed by the default `User-agent: *` group - no explicit entry needed.
Allow: /

# ===== TIER 2: AI training / bulk crawlers - BLOCKED (license to access) =====
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: anthropic-ai
User-agent: Claude-Web
User-agent: cohere-ai
User-agent: cohere-training-data-crawler
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: AI2Bot
User-agent: Meta-ExternalAgent
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: PanguBot
User-agent: Bytespider
User-agent: Diffbot
User-agent: Omgilibot
User-agent: Omgili
User-agent: FacebookBot
User-agent: ImagesiftBot
Disallow: /

Sitemap: https://www.crunchbase.com/www-sitemaps/sitemap-index.xml

}
.mat-drawer-container[fullscreen].mat-drawer-container-has-open {

.mat-drawer-container.mat-drawer-container-explicit-backdrop .mat-drawer-side {

.ng-animate-disabled .mat-drawer-container .mat-drawer-content {
  transition: none;
}

.mat-drawer-backdrop {
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  position: absolute;
  display: block;
  z-index: 3;
  visibility: hidden;
}
.mat-drawer-backdrop.mat-drawer-shown {

.mat-drawer-transition .mat-drawer-backdrop {
  transition-duration: 400ms;
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
  transition-property: background-color, visibility;
}
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .mat-drawer-backdrop {
    opacity: 0.5;
  }
}

.mat-drawer-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: auto;
}
.mat-drawer-content.mat-drawer-content-hidden {
  opacity: 0;
}
.mat-drawer-transition .mat-drawer-content {
  transition-duration: 400ms;
  transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
  transition-property: transform, margin-left, margin-right;
}

.mat-drawer {

  z-index: 4;

  width: var(--mat-sidenav-container-width, 360px);
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  outline: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  overflow-y: auto;
  transform: translate3d(-100%, 0, 0);
}
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .mat-drawer, [dir=rtl] .mat-drawer.mat-drawer-end {
    border-right: solid 1px currentColor;
  }
}
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  [dir=rtl] .mat-drawer, .mat-drawer.mat-drawer-end {
    border-left: solid 1px currentColor;
    border-right: none;
  }
}
.mat-drawer.mat-drawer-side {
  z-index: 2;
}
.mat-drawer.mat-drawer-end {

}

  border-top-right-radius: var(--mat-sidenav-container-shape, var(--mat-sys-corner-large));

  border-top-left-radius: 0;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 0;
  left: 0;

  transform: translate3d(-100%, 0, 0);
}
.mat-drawer-transition .mat-drawer {
  transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
}
.mat-drawer:not(.mat-drawer-opened):not(.mat-drawer-animating) {

}

}
.mat-drawer.mat-drawer-opened.mat-drawer-opened {

}

  border-left: none;
}

.mat-drawer-inner-container {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: auto;
}

.mat-sidenav-fixed {

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>
      Crunchbase | Private Company Data & Predictive Intelligence
    </title>
    <meta
      name="description"
      content="Discover private company data, funding insights, and AI-powered predictions with Crunchbase."
    />
    <style>
      @font-face {
        font-family: "Public Sans";
        font-style: normal;
        font-weight: 300 800;
        font-display: swap;
        src: url("/assets/static/static-pages/public-sans-latin.woff2")
          format("woff2");
      }

      :root {
        --ink: #102b38;
        --ink-deep: #071f2a;
        --ink-card: #08232f;
        --paper: #ffffff;
        --mist: #f2f7fb;
        --line: #dce6ed;
        --blue: #146aff;
        --blue-bright: #2877ff;
        --cta-light-blue: #d5edff;
        --cta-light-blue-hover: #bfe3ff;
        --cta-light-blue-active: #a9d9ff;
        --lilac: #d7c7ff;
        --muted: #b9c9d0;
        --upsell-background: #fad391;
        --upsell-active: #f8c165;
        --upsell-focus-border: 2px solid #fce4bd;
        --upsell-hover-shadow: 0 2px 4px 0 #cbd8df;
        --max: 1180px;
      }

      *,
      *::before,
      *::after {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      html {
        scroll-behavior: smooth;
      }

      body {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--paper);
        font-family: "Public Sans", Arial, sans-serif;
        font-size: 16px;
        line-height: 1.5;
      }

      a {
        color: inherit;
      }

      a:focus-visible,
      button:focus-visible,
      input:focus-visible + label {
        outline: 3px solid #78a7ff;
        outline-offset: 4px;
      }

      .sr-only {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        padding: 0;
        margin: -1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
        white-space: nowrap;
        border: 0;
      }

      .container {
        width: min(calc(100% - 48px), var(--max));
        margin-inline: auto;
      }

      .dark-shell {
        color: var(--paper);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at 82% 13%, #123e51 0, transparent 26rem),
          var(--ink);
      }

      .site-header {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 10;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        anchor-name: --static-homepage-header;
      }

      .nav {
        min-height: 68px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 28px;
      }

      .brand {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        text-decoration: none;
      }

      .brand-logo {
        display: block;
        width: 110px;
        height: auto;
      }

      .nav-links {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 24px;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
      }

      .nav-links > li {
        position: relative;
      }

      .nav-links > li > a {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        line-height: normal;
      }

      .nav-links a,
      .nav-dropdown-trigger,
      .nav-login {
        color: #d9e4e8;
        font-size: 13px;
        text-decoration: none;
      }

      .nav-links a:hover,
      .nav-dropdown-trigger:hover,
      .nav-links
        > li:has(> .nav-dropdown-panel:popover-open)
        .nav-dropdown-trigger,
      .nav-login:hover {
        color: var(--paper);
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 7px;
        padding: 0;
        font-family: inherit;
        background: transparent;
        border: 0;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger-solutions {
        anchor-name: --nav-solutions-trigger;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger-products {
        anchor-name: --nav-products-trigger;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger-resources {
        anchor-name: --nav-resources-trigger;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger::after {
        width: 6px;
        height: 6px;
        margin-top: -3px;
        border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor;
        border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor;
        content: "";
        transform: rotate(45deg);
        transition: transform 140ms ease;
      }

      .nav-links
        > li:has(> .nav-dropdown-panel:popover-open)
        .nav-dropdown-trigger::after {
        margin-top: 3px;
        transform: rotate(225deg);
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger:focus-visible {
        border-radius: 2px;
        outline: 3px solid #78a7ff;
        outline-offset: 4px;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel {
        position: fixed;
        inset: auto;
        top: 76px;
        left: 50%;
        display: none;
        width: 280px;
        max-height: calc(100dvh - 84px);
        gap: 4px;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 12px;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--paper);
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 10px;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(2, 20, 29, 0.24);
        list-style: none;
        overflow-y: auto;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel:popover-open {
        display: grid;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel a {
        display: grid;
        gap: 2px;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        color: var(--ink);
        border-radius: 6px;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel a:hover,
      .nav-dropdown-panel a:focus-visible {
        color: var(--ink-deep);
        background: var(--mist);
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel strong {
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel span {
        color: #526975;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.35;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel-solutions {
        width: 330px;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel-resources {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        width: 430px;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel::backdrop {
        background: transparent;
      }

      @supports (top: anchor(--static-homepage-header bottom)) {
        .nav-dropdown-panel {
          top: calc(anchor(--static-homepage-header bottom) + 8px);
          transform: none;
        }

        .nav-dropdown-panel-solutions {
          left: calc(anchor(--nav-solutions-trigger left) - 20px);
        }

          const fallbackLink = document.createElement("a");
          fallbackLink.href = fallbackUrl;
          fallbackLink.target = "_blank";
          fallbackLink.rel = "noopener";
          fallbackLink.textContent = "Click here";
          status.append(fallbackLink, " to get in touch!");
        };

        const getConsentCategories = activeGroups => ({
          ads: activeGroups.includes("C0004"),
          analytics: activeGroups.includes("C0002"),
          functionality: activeGroups.includes("C0003"),
          personalization: activeGroups.includes("C0005"),
          security: activeGroups.includes("C0001"),
        });

        const updateConsentCategories = event => {
          const activeGroups = event.detail;
          if (
            !Array.isArray(activeGroups) ||
            activeGroups.some(category => category.includes("BG"))
          ) {
            return;
          }

          const nextConsentCategories = getConsentCategories(activeGroups);
          const consentChanged =
            !consentCategories ||
            Object.keys(nextConsentCategories).some(
              category =>
                consentCategories[category] !== nextConsentCategories[category],
            );
          const consentWasResolved = Boolean(consentCategories);
          consentCategories = nextConsentCategories;
          window.cbGtmConsent = consentCategories;

          if (
            consentWasResolved &&
            consentChanged &&
            marketoState === "loading"
          ) {
            finishMarketo(
              "idle",
              "Cookie preferences changed. Please try again.",
            );
          }

          if (analyticsInitialized) {
            if (!gtmInjected) {
              injectGtm();
            } else if (consentWasResolved && consentChanged) {
              reportGtmConsentUpdate();
            }
          }

          requestMarketoInitialization();

          if (consentCategories.functionality && chatbotConsentBlocked) {
            chatbotUnavailable = false;
            chatbotConsentBlocked = false;
            qualifiedRequested = false;
            setSalesStatus("");
          }

          if (chatbotRequestActive) {
            if (consentCategories.functionality) {
              startQualifiedCampaign();
            } else {
              failChatbotRequest("error", true);
            }
          }
        };

        window.addEventListener(
          "OneTrustGroupsUpdated",
          updateConsentCategories,
        );

        const oneTrustScript = document.createElement("script");
        oneTrustScript.src =
          "https://cdn.cookielaw.org/scripttemplates/otSDKStub.js";
        oneTrustScript.async = true;
        oneTrustScript.dataset.domainScript =
          "d71c660f-7eb5-4a5e-983e-ca1d7f1e56d4";
        document.head.append(oneTrustScript);

        let sendUsageEvent = () => undefined;

        const reportGtmEvent = (event, payload) => {
          window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
          window.dataLayer.push({ event, ...payload });
        };

        const reportGtmCommand = function () {
          window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
          window.dataLayer.push(arguments);
        };

        const reportGtmConsentUpdate = () => {
          const consentState = granted => (granted ? "granted" : "denied");
          reportGtmCommand("consent", "update", {
            ad_storage: consentState(consentCategories.ads),
            analytics_storage: consentState(consentCategories.analytics),
            functionality_storage: consentState(
              consentCategories.functionality,
            ),
            personalization_storage: consentState(
              consentCategories.personalization,
            ),
            security_storage: "granted",
          });
        };

        const openSalesFallback = () => {
          const fallbackUrl = activeSalesFallbackUrl;
          if (fallbackUrl && window.open(fallbackUrl, "_blank")) {
            setSalesStatus("");
            return;
          }

          if (fallbackUrl) {
            setSalesFallbackStatus(fallbackUrl);
          }
        };

        const finishChatbotRequest = () => {
          chatbotRequestActive = false;
          pendingQualifiedIdentity = undefined;
          clearTimeout(chatbotTimeout);
          clearTimeout(chatbotFeedbackTimeout);
        };

        const failChatbotRequest = (status, consentBlocked = false) => {
          if (!chatbotRequestActive) {
            return;
          }

          chatbotUnavailable = true;
          chatbotConsentBlocked = consentBlocked;
          finishChatbotRequest();
          sendUsageEvent("chatbot_campaign_error", {
            chatbotCampaign: chatCampaign,
            chatbotStatus: status,
          });
          openSalesFallback();
        };

        const injectGtm = () => {
          if (gtmInjected) {
            return;
          }

          gtmInjected = true;
          window.cbGtmConsent = consentCategories;
          reportGtmEvent("gtm.js", { "gtm.start": Date.now() });
          const gtmScript = document.createElement("script");
          gtmScript.async = true;
          gtmScript.src =
            "https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id=GTM-MCH8573";
          gtmScript.addEventListener("error", () => {
            gtmUnavailable = true;
            failChatbotRequest("error");
            failMarketo();
          });
          document.head.append(gtmScript);
        };

        const startQualifiedCampaign = () => {
          if (
            !chatbotRequestActive ||
            !consentCategories ||
            qualifiedRequested
          ) {
            return;
          }

          if (!consentCategories.functionality) {
            failChatbotRequest("error", true);
            return;
          }

          if (gtmUnavailable) {
            failChatbotRequest("error");
            return;
          }

          injectGtm();
          qualifiedRequested = true;
          reportGtmEvent("getHelp", { showHelpChat: false });
        };

        const getSalesIdentity = () => {
          const fieldIds = [
            "closing-sales-first-name",
            "closing-sales-last-name",
            "closing-sales-email",
            "closing-sales-company",
          ];
          const fields = fieldIds.map(fieldId =>
            document.getElementById(fieldId),
          );
          if (
            fields.some(
              field =>
                !(field instanceof HTMLInputElement) ||
                !field.value.trim() ||
                !field.checkValidity(),
            )
          ) {
            return;
          }

          return {
            first_name: fields[0].value.trim(),
            last_name: fields[1].value.trim(),
            email: fields[2].value.trim(),
            company: fields[3].value.trim(),
          };
        };

        const identifyQualifiedVisitor = identity => {
          if (!identity || typeof window.qualified !== "function") {
            return;
          }

          try {
            window.qualified("identify", identity);
          } catch {}
        };

        window.addEventListener("chatbotReady", () => {
          chatbotReady = true;
          if (!chatbotRequestActive) {
            return;
          }

          if (!consentCategories?.functionality) {
            failChatbotRequest("error", true);
            return;
          }

          const qualifiedIdentity = pendingQualifiedIdentity;
          finishChatbotRequest();
          setSalesStatus("");
          identifyQualifiedVisitor(qualifiedIdentity);
          reportGtmEvent("sidePanelState", { sidePanelState: "none" });
          reportGtmEvent("startChatbotCampaign", {
            chatbotCampaign: chatCampaign,
          });
        });

        const requestSalesCampaign = salesLink => {
          activeSalesStatus = salesLink
            .closest("li")
            ?.querySelector("[data-sales-status]");
          activeSalesFallbackUrl = salesLink.href;
          initializeAnalytics();
          sendUsageEvent("chatbot_campaign_start", {
            chatbotCampaign: salesLink.dataset.salesCampaign,
          });

          if (chatbotUnavailable) {
            return false;
          }

          const qualifiedIdentity = getSalesIdentity();

          if (consentCategories && !consentCategories.functionality) {
            chatbotRequestActive = true;
            failChatbotRequest("error", true);
            return true;
          }

          if (chatbotReady) {
            identifyQualifiedVisitor(qualifiedIdentity);
            reportGtmEvent("sidePanelState", { sidePanelState: "none" });
            reportGtmEvent("startChatbotCampaign", {
              chatbotCampaign: chatCampaign,
            });
            return true;
          }

          if (!chatbotRequestActive) {
            chatbotRequestActive = true;
            pendingQualifiedIdentity = qualifiedIdentity;
            chatbotFeedbackTimeout = setTimeout(
              () =>
                setSalesStatus("Give us a moment, our sales team is loading"),
              chatbotFeedbackDelayMs,
            );
            chatbotTimeout = setTimeout(
              () => failChatbotRequest("timeout"),
              chatbotLoadTimeoutMs,
            );
            startQualifiedCampaign();
          }

          return true;
        };

        document.addEventListener("click", event => {
          const target =
            event.target instanceof Element ? event.target : undefined;
          const preferenceControl = target?.closest(
            "[data-open-cookie-preferences]",
          );

          if (preferenceControl instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
            openCookiePreferences();
            return;
          }

          const salesLink = target?.closest("a[data-sales-campaign]");

          if (
            salesLink instanceof HTMLAnchorElement &&
            requestSalesCampaign(salesLink)
          ) {
            event.preventDefault();
          }
        });

        const marketoSalesForm = document.getElementById("closing-sales-form");
        const marketoStatus = document.getElementById("closing-sales-status");
        const marketoButton = marketoSalesForm.querySelector(
          "button[type=submit]",
        );
        let marketoState = "idle";
        let marketoRequestId = 0;
        let marketoValues;
        let marketoTimeout;
        let marketoInitRequested = false;

        const finishMarketo = (state, message) => {
          clearTimeout(marketoTimeout);
          marketoState = state;
          marketoValues = undefined;
          marketoButton.disabled = state === "success" || state === "uncertain";
          marketoSalesForm.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
          marketoStatus.textContent = message;
        };

        const markSubmissionUncertain = () =>
          finishMarketo(
            "uncertain",
            "We couldn't confirm your request. Please wait before trying again.",
          );

        const failMarketo = () => {
          if (marketoState !== "loading") return;
          finishMarketo("idle", "");
          const fallback = new URL(marketoSalesForm.action);
          const incoming = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
          [
            "utm_source",
            "utm_medium",
            "utm_campaign",
            "utm_content",
            "utm_term",
            "gclid",
          ].forEach(key => {
            if (incoming.has(key))
              fallback.searchParams.set(key, incoming.get(key));
          });
          setSalesFallbackStatus(fallback.href, marketoStatus);
        };

        const requestMarketoInitialization = () => {
          if (
            marketoState !== "loading" ||
            !consentCategories ||
            marketoInitRequested
          )
            return;
          if (gtmUnavailable) return failMarketo();
          marketoInitRequested = true;
          injectGtm();
          window.cbHomepageMarketoRequestId = marketoRequestId;
          reportGtmEvent("homepage_sales_form_init", {
            form_id: 1990,
            request_id: marketoRequestId,
          });
        };

        const isMarketoResponse = event =>
          event.detail?.form_id === 1990 &&
          event.detail.request_id === marketoRequestId;

        window.addEventListener("homepage_sales_form_ready", event => {
          if (!isMarketoResponse(event) || marketoState !== "loading") return;
          try {
            const form = window.MktoForms2?.getForm(1990);
            if (!form) return failMarketo();
            form.setValues(marketoValues);
            if (!form.validate()) {
              finishMarketo("idle", "Please check your details and try again.");
              return;
            }
            clearTimeout(marketoTimeout);
            marketoState = "submitting";
            marketoTimeout = setTimeout(markSubmissionUncertain, 30_000);
            form.submit();
          } catch {
            if (marketoState === "loading") failMarketo();
            else markSubmissionUncertain();
          }
        });

        window.addEventListener("homepage_sales_form_error", event => {
          if (isMarketoResponse(event)) failMarketo();
        });
        window.addEventListener("homepage_sales_form_success", event => {
          if (
            isMarketoResponse(event) &&
            ["submitting", "uncertain"].includes(marketoState)
          ) {
            finishMarketo(
              "success",
              "Thanks! Your request was sent. Redirecting…",
            );
            marketoSalesForm.replaceWith(marketoStatus);
            marketoStatus.focus();
            setTimeout(() => {
              location.assign(
                "https://about.crunchbase.com/form-submit-business",
              );
            }, 2000);
          }
        });

        marketoSalesForm.addEventListener("submit", event => {
          event.preventDefault();
          if (marketoState !== "idle") return;
          const identity = getSalesIdentity();
          if (!identity) {
            marketoStatus.textContent = "Please complete all fields.";
            return;
          }
          marketoValues = {
            FirstName: identity.first_name,
            LastName: identity.last_name,
            Email: identity.email,
            Company: identity.company,
          };
          marketoState = "loading";
          marketoRequestId++;
          marketoInitRequested = false;
          marketoButton.disabled = true;
          marketoSalesForm.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
          marketoStatus.textContent = "Sending your request…";
          marketoTimeout = setTimeout(failMarketo, 20_000);
          initializeAnalytics();
          requestMarketoInitialization();
        });

        const interactionEvents = [
          "keydown",
          "pointerdown",
          "pointermove",
          "scroll",
        ];
        const interactionStorageKey = "cb_user_interacted";
        let analyticsInitialized = false;

        const initializeAnalytics = () => {
          if (analyticsInitialized) {
            return;
          }

          analyticsInitialized = true;
          try {
            sessionStorage.setItem(interactionStorageKey, "true");

          }
          interactionEvents.forEach(eventType => {
            window.removeEventListener(eventType, initializeAnalytics, {
              passive: true,
            });

          const endpoint = "/v4/cb/events/clientapp";
          const instanceId = crypto.randomUUID
            ? crypto.randomUUID()
            : `${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`;
          const upsellAttributionStorageKey =
            "cb_static_homepage_upsell_attribution";
          const upsellAttributionTtlMs = 60_000;

          sendUsageEvent = (eventType, analyticsProperties) => {
            const event = {
              event_type: eventType,
              user_agent: navigator.userAgent,
              uri: location.href,
              client_timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            };

            if (
              analyticsProperties &&
              Object.keys(analyticsProperties).length
            ) {
              event.analytics_properties = analyticsProperties;
            }

            void fetch(endpoint, {
              method: "POST",
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest",
                "x-cb-client-app-instance-id": instanceId,
              },
              body: JSON.stringify({ events: [event] }),
              credentials: "same-origin",
              keepalive: true,
            }).catch(() => undefined);
          };

          let documentReferrer = document.referrer;
          try {
            documentReferrer =
              sessionStorage.getItem("cf_original_referrer") ||
              documentReferrer;
          } catch {
            // Keep document.referrer when storage is unavailable.
          }

          sendUsageEvent(
            "navigation",
            documentReferrer
              ? { document_referrer: documentReferrer }
              : undefined,
          );

          document.addEventListener("click", event => {
            const target =
              event.target instanceof Element ? event.target : undefined;

            const globalNavItem = target?.closest(
              "[data-global-nav-type][data-global-nav-label]",
            );

            if (globalNavItem instanceof HTMLElement) {
              sendUsageEvent("global_nav_click", {
                type: globalNavItem.dataset.globalNavType,
                label: globalNavItem.dataset.globalNavLabel,
                version: "global_nav_2025",
              });
            }

            const homepageCta = target?.closest("a[data-homepage-cta-action]");

            if (homepageCta instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) {
              sendUsageEvent("homepage_cta_click", {
                action: homepageCta.dataset.homepageCtaAction,
                label: homepageCta.textContent.trim(),
                destination: homepageCta.getAttribute("href"),
                trigger_location: "hero",
              });
            }

            const link = target?.closest("a[data-upsell-trigger-location]");

            if (!(link instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) {
              return;
            }

            try {
              sessionStorage.setItem(
                upsellAttributionStorageKey,
                JSON.stringify({
                  source_client_app_instance_id: instanceId,
                  expires_at: Date.now() + upsellAttributionTtlMs,
                }),
              );
            } catch {
              // Continue navigation when storage is unavailable.
            }

            sendUsageEvent("upsell_link", {
              landing_page: new URL(link.href).pathname,
              trigger_location: link.dataset.upsellTriggerLocation,
            });
          });

          if (consentCategories) {
            injectGtm();
          }
        };

        let hasInteracted = false;
        try {
          hasInteracted =
            sessionStorage.getItem(interactionStorageKey) === "true";
        } catch {
          // Wait for interaction when storage is unavailable.
        }

        if (hasInteracted) {
          initializeAnalytics();
        } else {
          interactionEvents.forEach(eventType => {
            window.addEventListener(eventType, initializeAnalytics, {
              passive: true,
            });
          });
        }
      })();
